subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Departure: June 15th, 2022 at 10:00 AM Arrival: June 15th, 2022 at 2:00 PM We hope you have a pleasant journey and look forward to welcoming you on board. Should you require any assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. Best regards, The Travel Agency
